pullRequests.title: Match func_L00_001F5C60 (debug menu draw, 4,884 bytes)
pullRequests.author: dev-gian
pullRequests.head: feat/debug-menu-draw
pullRequests.body:
func_L00_001F5C60 matched byte-for-byte, in one commit. It is the largest function matched so far: 4,884 bytes, the debug menu draw in src/overlays/shared/draw_001F3A78.c.
Matched code goes from 78.629% to 78.760% (4,225 to 4,226 functions).
How it was found: the staged near miss in nonmatching/shared/ was one byte off. decomp-permuter (via tools/permuter_setup.py) found a change that closes it, and I applied only that change to the readable source, with proper names:

the format-string pointer…

commits.headline: refactor(moby): name the moby words at 0x80, 0x86, 0xB1 and 0xB6
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
Matched code reads and writes them: the level loader's moby records set a
colour word at 0x80 and the bytes at 0xB1 and 0xB6 (func_L00_002422D8),
and func_L02_002D9F08 compares the half-word at 0x86 with 5. They were
padding in the shared struct, so the private copies that named them could
not be replaced without writing to pad fields. The layout is unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.headline: refactor(overlays): include/moby.h in place of 8 private moby copies, l01_novalis (3 files)
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
The private moby and moby class structs of these files become the shared
Moby and MobyClass, and vector types identical to Vec4f become Vec4f. An
access whose old type differs from the shared field at the same offset
keeps that type through a cast on the shared field's address, so no
compiled byte changes.

Verified: overlay_file_check, 0 problems.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
